svg.title: Ontario SPCA canine dental cleaning with no extractions, 465 dollars
svg.desc: Bars for the six priced lines inside canine COHAT 1 at the Ontario SPCA York Region clinic: exam 60, induction 100, anaesthetic maintenance 150, IV fluids 45, scaling and polish 80, and radiographs 30. They add to 465 dollars. Bloodwork is excluded.
svg.text: Ontario SPCA York Region. Cleaning, no extractions. Scale: 465 dollars = 400 px. Bloodwork is outside this package.
60 plus 100 plus 150 plus 45 plus 80 plus 30 equals 465. Oral surgery time on this level is 0 dollars.
A pre-anaesthetic blood panel is 145 dollars and is not in the green total. COHAT 5 on the summary table is 1,705 dollars.
OVMA 2025 lists professional dental care at 1,320 dollars as a provincial average. That is a different figure and is not a bar here.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Two other canine breakdowns on the same page do not match their summaries. Re-read before you pay.
